spots.name: Cape Kumukahi Light
spots.tip: Lighthouses make strong silhouettes at dusk and pair well with blue hour once the light is on.

spots.name: Kehena Beach
spots.tip: Low tide and wet sand give reflections at sunset. Check the tide table and never turn your back on the waves.

spots.name: Puʻuhonuaʻula
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 258 m (846 ft).
